_comment: What scripts/import_fixtures.js pulls into data/fixtures.json. Hide leagues per phone in the app's Settings > Followed competitions.

espnSoccer._comment: Every ESPN soccer league. allDays: import everything this many days ahead; after that, only mainSlugs up to days. Slugs are listed in data/espn_leagues.json.

apiSportsBasketball._comment: Needs the API_SPORTS_KEY secret. Free plan: only yesterday, today and tomorrow (pastDays 1, days 2).

favorites._comment: Favourite teams are chosen in the app (Settings > Favourite teams) and stored in data/picks.json. Their next game is imported from TheSportsDB even when no other source lists it.
